_readme: 慎用藥 slug 名單 —— 「這味藥出現在組成表時，該卡必須有安全欄文字」。
MEMBERSHIP MEANS: a card whose composition contains one of these herb_id
slugs MUST carry at least one non-empty safety string
(contraindications_zh / contraindications_en / cautions_zh / cautions_en).
MEMBERSHIP DOES NOT MEAN: the herb is banned, obsolete, unsafe at any dose,
or that the formula should be withdrawn. 大黃 · 麻黃 · 桃仁 · 附子 are all
standard, dispensable, board-list herbs. This file is a list of herbs whose
cards may not be SILENT — nothing more.
SOURCE: docs/research_packs/FORMULA_EYESON_03.md §3.1「LIBRARY-COMPLETE
慎用藥覆蓋矩陣」(63 卡母體，三批人眼讀完) and the P1 slug set written out in
§3.2. The family grouping below is §3.1's own section order.
KEYED BY herb_id SLUG, NOT BY CHINESE SUBSTRING — this is the whole point.
FORMULA_EYESON_03 F-46: `composition[].herb_zh` is romanized on 102 rows /
57 cards (`"Zhi Chuan Wu"`, `"Shui Fei Zhu Sha"`), so a Chinese-substring
scan returns FALSE NEGATIVES on exactly the two most dangerous cards in the
library (xiao_huo_luo_dan 川烏+草烏 同方, zhu_sha_an_shen_wan 硃砂為君).
Matching is EXACT slug equality after stripping the `herb.` prefix, so
`ma_huang_gen`(麻黃根, a different herb) does not match `ma_huang`, and
`bai_fu_zi`/`lai_fu_zi` do not match `fu_zi` — the batch-2 `mu_li_san`
false positive and its mirror image are both closed by construction.
KNOWN BLIND SPOT (F-47): a card whose composition table belongs to a
DIFFERENT formula is invisible to any composition-keyed scan, herb_id or
not — `formula.xie_xin_tang` carries 半夏瀉心湯's table and therefore has no
大黃 row to match. That class is detected by
scripts/validate-formula-composition-signatures.js (FB-20/FB-28), not here.
The reader script also reports rows it CANNOT classify (empty herb_id with a
romanized herb_zh) so the coverage claim stays honest.
READ BY: scripts/validate-formula-safety-predicates.js (P1).
Adding a slug widens P1's mother lode and may raise the violation count —
that is intended; do not remove a slug to make a number go down.
